mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the Federal Funds Rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in unemployment (PAYEMS below 5,000) signals a strengthening labor market, boosting consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The unemployment rate does not fall below 5,000 in the relevant period, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in both GDP (GDPC1) and business investment demand (RSAFS) signal robust economic growth, amplifying equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and RSAFS rising > 1% in the prior month
failure_condition: The combined growth of GDPC1 and RSAFS does not exceed 1% in the prior month, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the Federal Funds Rate and contraction in supply (INDPRO) below critical thresholds indicates easing policy amid supply-side pressures, fostering market optimism and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The combination of FEDFUNDS not falling below 3.0% or INDPRO not dropping below 95, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in the CPI inflation index (CPIAUCSL) below 1.5% during a late-cycle expansion regime signals anticipated Federal Reserve rate cuts, reducing long-term interest rates and boosting equity valuations for the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL does not fall below 1.5% in the late-cycle regime, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment (PAYEMS) below 5,000 and tightening monetary policy (FEDFUNDS > 3.5%) creates conflicting signals, undermining market confidence and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The combination of PAYEMS not falling below 5,000 or FEDFUNDS not rising above 3.5%, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in GDP (GDPC1) above 19,000 billions of chained 2017 dollars signals robust demand, driving corporate profits and equity valuations higher, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 does not exceed 19,000 in the relevant period, or 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A surge in GDP (GDPC1) alongside a contraction in supply (INDPRO) below critical levels indicates strong demand outpacing production, fostering inflationary pressures and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The combined growth of GDPC1 does not exceed 2% or INDPRO does not fall below 1% in the relevant period, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).
